patterns.description: Add Circuit.eval_id_apply, a pointwise corollary of Circuit.eval_id.
Use simp to prove Circuit.eval_id without changing its proposition; the S1 corollary depends on it.

Express Circuit.eval with an explicit output function and remove the now-unused composition simp rule from eval_id; behavior and theorem propositions are preserved while dependent content addresses change.
Revert the Circuit.eval implementation change, restoring the S2 source tree while retaining the cumulative proof corpus.

sequence.timingPolicy: Run validation, export, planning, proving, independent verification, and warm repeat sequentially so builds do not contend with timed proving.

notes: All stages use full import Cslib exports on Lean 4.34.1 and the same frozen prover binary, dependency pins, and axiom policy.
The synthetic commits are a sequential chain, each proven against its immediate predecessor's cumulative catalog.
Plan-only and prove are separate measured commands; both costs are reported. Prove reuses the pending plan but includes certificate validation and final verification.
New leaf proof count measures claims actually proven; historically new constants measure declarations first added to the cumulative corpus.
Cached leaf rows carry proof size and identity but no new execution/proving time. Their creation costs are in the baseline report or earlier stages.
Prover worker durations can overlap; they are not wall time. Inclusive root timing already contains the separately listed recursive wraps.

Per-proof CSV deduplicates aggregate objects within each attempt. Intermediate persisted aggregate objects have sizes and addresses; root-wrap rows report overlapping substeps of the inclusive root duration.
All visible GPUs and automatic host memory budgeting are enabled. Small incremental dependencies may expose too little concurrent work to keep both GPUs busy.
GPU samples are taken once per second; measured cgroup memory peak includes the job's child processes and charged file pages.
